title: Asymptotic Schur orthogonality for lattices
summary: Let $π:G\to \mathcal{U}(L^{2}(G/P,ν))$ be the boundary representation of a non-compact connected semisimple Lie group $G$ with finite center on its Furstenberg-Poisson boundary $(G/P,ν)$. Let $Γ\subset G$ be a lattice in $G$ (uniform or not). We show that for any \emph{continuous} functions $\varphi,ψ,\varphi',ψ'$ on $G/P$, $$ \lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{1}{|Γ_{n}|}\sum_{γ\in Γ_{n}}\frac{\langleπ(γ)\varphi,ψ\rangle\overline{\langleπ(γ)\varphi',ψ'\rangle}}{Ξ^{2}(γ)}=\langle \varphi,\varphi'\rangle\overline{\langleψ,ψ'\rangle}, $$ where $Γ_{n}$ is a ball in $Γ$ with radius $n$ relative to a natural…
